title: Vectra component
description: One file per component in site/data/components/. The single source of truth for the docs site and, later, the AI manifest (M8b). Markup strings are what a person copies: icons use the README form <use href="/icons/sprite.svg#name"/>.

slug.description: Equals the file name; the page lives at components/<slug>/.

status.description: done: CSS and any JS shipped. partial: CSS shipped, behaviour still to come.

summary.description: One sentence: what it is and when to use it.

description.description: Optional longer intro, plain text, one or two short paragraphs separated by a blank line.

native.description: The native element or attribute it builds on, e.g. <dialog>, popover, <details name>.

catalogue.description: CATALOGUE.md section 2 row names this entry covers (the text before any bracket).

css.description: Files in src/css/components/ (without path) that style it.

js.description: Files in src/js/ that add behaviour, e.g. components/copy.js.

states.description: Native attributes and ARIA that drive the look or the behaviour.

hooks.description: data-v-* attributes read by the JS. Every name must exist in src/js.

value.description: What the attribute value holds, empty when it is a flag.

api.description: JavaScript functions on window.Vectra (or ES exports) that drive it.

keys.description: Alternatives, each one key or a combo written Shift+Tab.

a11y.description: Accessibility notes, one sentence or two each.

tokens.description: Custom properties it reads that a person may want to set; component tokens first.

html.description: The markup, indented with two spaces, no data-contrast or gallery-only classes (ex-*).

js.description: Optional script run in the demo (an ES module with window.Vectra available) and shown under the markup.

height.description: Demo frame height in px before JS sizes it (and the size without JS). Default 160.

layout.description: How the demo body arranges the markup. Default row (wrapping cluster).

source.description: Gallery the markup was verified against, e.g. examples/components/#buttons.
